messages:
Zoe: dropped a quick variant that puts actions in a trailing overflow instead of inline — figma: https://figma.redwood/summ-v5 :mag:
Arjun: I like overflow for density, but hover-only actions are a11y trap. Need a keyboard-visible affordance.
Noor: agree. spec idea: the action menu must be reachable by Tab as a single control, label 'More actions' with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.
Ben: for `Copy signature` we should support a direct keyboard shortcut when a card is focused, plus a focusable invisible button that becomes visible on keyboard focus. not hover-only.
Zoe: micro-copy decision: primary expand button -> 'View full output', secondary -> 'Copy signature'. keep labels identical across Playground and Run History.
Arjun: visual nudge: add a :page_facing_up: badge when examples exist, with tiny tooltip 'Has examples' to reduce clicks.
Noor: SR flow sketch: 'Tool call, summarize_text, collapsed, 4 fields.' On expand: 'Expanded. Use arrow keys to navigate fields. Field 1 of 4: text.' keep reads concise.
Zoe: tiny inline JSON I dropped in the mock:
```json
{ "name": "summarize_text", "params": { "text": "Long document content...", "length": "short" } }
```
Ben: truncation plan: ellipsize after ~36 chars, show full name in tooltip on hover, and announce full name to screen readers on focus. use middle dot in header: 'summarize_text \u00b7 12ms'.
Arjun: spacing debate — ops pushed for 44px rows, design prefers 56px. proposing 50px compromise and running keyboard/focus tests.
Noor: contrast/accessibility: header weights need bumping to meet 4.5:1. also ensure focus ring is >=3px and high contrast at small sizes.
Ben: keyboard navigation pattern: Tab lands on the list container, Arrow keys move between cards, Enter toggles expand (move focus to first field), Esc collapses and returns focus to card.
Zoe: this feels solid. I'll iterate and upload updated PNGs later.
mock-bot: Uploaded Figma v5: https://figma.redwood/summ-v5 (comments resolved).
Arjun: thanks — I'll prototype the overflow keyboard pattern tomorrow. :sparkles:
